Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

imprintomeR 1.6.0

This release focuses on installation, reproducibility and documentation. Sample-level scores (IDS, Angle, Mechanism, Status) and per-ICR calls with default settings are unchanged from 1.5.3.

Installation

  • DESCRIPTION has biocViews, so BiocManager::install(), remotes and pak resolve the Bioconductor dependencies (minfi, ComplexHeatmap). The README installs with BiocManager and lists the system libraries Linux needs (curl, OpenSSL and libxml2 headers).
  • Fewer required packages: pheatmap, Rtsne and cowplot moved to Suggests, and the functions that use them say so when one is missing. ewastools and Vennerable are no longer used.
  • Control-probe and SNP quality control in runMethQC() (control metrics, genotype calls, sample-swap check, predicted donors) is now native code that follows ewastools 1.8.2 (Heiss and Just 2018) and gives identical values on 450K, EPICv1 and EPICv2 IDATs, so ewastools no longer needs to be installed. contamination is now one long table (donor1, sample1, donor2, sample2, agreement, group). run_meth_QC.R --skip-ewastools is kept as a deprecated, ignored flag.
  • The data-file note at startup moved from .onLoad() to .onAttach().

Example data and documentation

  • New example data: beta values of the 782 selected panel probes for the 28 samples of GEO GSE52576 (450K), with their metadata, read with imprintome_example(). The README Quick start runs as pasted, on this example and on the minfiData IDATs.
  • Website: https://hongjianjin.github.io/imprintomeR/, with the function reference grouped by task, the vignettes, the guides (QC, analysis, plots, probesets, command line, FAQ) and the worked GEO examples.
  • The README documents the input files of both entry points (IDAT files for runMethQC(), a beta matrix for ImprintomeSet()).
  • The three vignettes now run on the example data when the package is built.
  • New FAQ on choosing cutoffs and interpreting results.
  • supplementary/Supplementary_Code.R runs every workflow example of the Application Note’s Supplementary on public data.
  • benchmark/download_heldout.R downloads the held-out benchmark files from GEO and checks their size and SHA-256.
  • Repository: the notebooks moved to tutorials/ (GSE52567.ipynb renamed GSE52576.ipynb) and the guides to vignettes/articles/. The MCP server and agent skill moved to their own repository, https://github.com/hongjianjin/imprintomeR-agent, and an unused legacy file was removed.

New features

  • With n_boot > 0, AnalyzeImprintStatus() and runImprintome() add Status_interval: whether the IDS interval lies above, below or across the cutoff. Confidence (exploratory 0.1/0.2/0.4 IDS bands) is kept.
  • run_imprintomeR.R has the uncertainty options --n-boot, --resample, --resample-reference, --n-perm, --permute, --conf-level and --seed; a seed is drawn and logged when none is given, and the log records the package version and the arguments. Beta files are streamed and only panel probes are kept (--all-probes to load all), so genome-wide files no longer need to fit in memory.
  • PlotPolar() is exported. Polar colours are stable (sorted group names, control or normal groups grey and drawn on top), labels wrap, and the radial axis extends when IDS exceeds 0.8 (such samples were dropped before).
  • PlotICRHeatmap() sizes itself to the numbers of ICRs and samples and hides sample names above 300 samples; export() uses the stored size. beeswarm_origin and mirror_density take samples from each group in turn and state how many are shown.
  • ImprintomeSet() stops with an explanation when beta values lie outside 0 to 1 (percentages or M-values), which previously called every sample altered.

Changed behaviour

  • Mechanism ROI and Mechanism_support follow ids_cutoff instead of a fixed 0.2, so Status and Mechanism agree for any cutoff. Results with the default cutoff (0.2) are unchanged.

Bug fixes

  • runMethQC(): predictedSex was NA whenever Sample_Name differed from the IDAT name.
  • runMethQC(): Bisulfite Conversion I Green was misreported on 450K arrays (minfi’s manifest misnames two of its probes), and the contamination table repeated rows or failed, losing predictedDonorID, when donor groups differed in size.
  • check_platform() returned minfi’s "450k" instead of the documented "450K".
  • Probe-level plots (violin, beeswarm and others) failed when the metadata’s row names were not the sample IDs, and several plot helpers mishandled a beta matrix (as stored in an ImprintomeSet).
  • The correlation heatmap failed on missing beta values and left a PDF device open, so later heatmaps were drawn into it; BetaHeatmapByGene() returned its heatmap invisibly, so it was not drawn; Beeplot_chr_vs_other() needed outFile.
  • export(save_plots = TRUE) failed on the per-ICR heatmap.
  • Excel export failed when two metadata columns differed only by letter case (for example a sample sheet’s status and the Status added by check_platform()); the later one is renamed with a suffix.
  • PNG output (BetaCircularHeatmap(), export(plot_device = "png")) uses ragg when installed, so it works without X11 or cairo (for example on macOS without XQuartz).
  • The origin permutation falls back from whole ICRs to probes, with a warning, on panels with one ICR per parental class (such as chr11p15) also through runImprintome() and the command line, as documented; these stopped with an error.
  • run_imprintomeR.R without --icr no longer ends with a “differing number of rows” error.
  • The many type.convert() warnings from minfi::qcReport() are silenced.

Testing

  • GitHub Actions run R CMD check (with the vignettes) on Linux, macOS and Windows, and a clean install as the README says, followed by the Quick start and the Supplementary companion script, on every change and weekly.

imprintomeR 1.5.3 and earlier

See the release notes on GitHub: https://github.com/hongjianjin/imprintomeR/releases
